title: Kodersolution.com
desc: Full-stack developer platform and learning ecosystem featuring technical articles, programming tutorials, student resources, and community forums.
overview: An interactive developer platform engineered to share high-quality technical articles, step-by-step programming tutorials, student learning tracks, and real-time community forums covering Laravel, React, Next.js, and system architecture.
challenges: Architecting a high-throughput content management and forum engine capable of handling concurrent student discussions and article reads.
Optimizing full-text search and real-time forum notifications for active developer threads.
Ensuring fast page load times and optimal SEO indexation for thousands of technical tutorials.
solutions: Engineered a hybrid Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) system using Next.js and Laravel REST APIs.
Implemented Redis caching and optimized database indexing for instantaneous search results and thread updates.
Designed structured JSON-LD schemas and dynamic metadata pipelines to maximize SEO indexing and search visibility.
impact: Grew into a primary learning hub for developers and engineering students, delivering real-time forum discussions, fast article searches, and thousands of monthly active readers.

title: Peaklancer.com
desc: Freelance services marketplace platform facilitating secure client-freelancer contracts, escrow payments, and service gigs.
overview: A modern freelance services marketplace built to connect global businesses with skilled freelancers. Features digital service gigs, custom offer proposals, secure milestone payments, direct real-time chat, and automated order dispute handling.
challenges: Building a multi-currency escrow payment engine with secure holding and payout verification.
Implementing instant real-time messaging and order attachment uploads between buyers and sellers.
Designing complex commission calculation and dispute resolution workflows.
solutions: Engineered an automated payment escrow pipeline enforcing double-entry transaction checks before releasing funds.
Utilized WebSockets and Redis channels for instant messaging and order updates.
Developed a robust admin governance portal for managing gig moderation, order cancellations, and refunds.
impact: Engineered a high-performing digital marketplace supporting seamless gig creation, real-time client communications, and secure payment processing.

title: Payment Gateway Integration
desc: Payment routing system with direct integrations to major local banking networks.
overview: A transaction-heavy backend service built to route payments directly to local banking systems, featuring transaction checks, webhook sequencing, and automated reconciliation.
challenges: Lock contention and double-payment bugs under highly concurrent callbacks.
Varying and inconsistent response formats from different bank endpoints.
Out-of-order webhook delivery causing transaction state corruption.
solutions: Implemented distributed locking using Redis to block duplicate callbacks.
Built a normalized adapter layer to standardize all incoming API payloads.
Designed a database transaction logging queue to enforce state transitions.
impact: Successfully handled payment callbacks for thousands of daily checkouts with zero duplicate payments and an average routing latency under 200ms.

title: School ERP Portal
desc: School administration system managing academic calendars, attendance, and reporting.
overview: An all-in-one portal managing student life cycles from registration and class scheduling to automated report card generation.
challenges: Generating high-volume PDF report cards on demand during finals week, causing server timeouts.
Designing complex multi-class schedule matrices without room or teacher collisions.
Slow loading student profile histories containing attendance and grading tables.
solutions: Offloaded PDF generation tasks to a distributed background worker queue.
Developed a custom scheduling validation engine to block booking conflicts.
Optimized query paths and introduced eager-loading for relationships.
impact: Successfully deployed in multiple schools, reducing final-term reporting overhead from several days to a few hours.

title: HRM & Payroll Engine
desc: Human resource management platform managing employee records, attendance, and payroll.
overview: A payroll-focused HRM engine that handles work shifts, salary disbursement, tax deductions, and compliance records.
challenges: Custom calculations for shifts, overtime, holidays, and employee tax variables.
Keeping sensitive payroll and salary information encrypted yet searchable by managers.
Slow report queries running over thousands of active employee records.
solutions: Built a custom payroll engine utilizing dynamic formula evaluators.
Implemented column-level AES database encryption combined with blind index search.
Created materialized views and query optimization structures to cache reports.
impact: Automated payroll calculations, ensuring zero calculation errors and cutting pay processing time by 75%.

title: Garments ERP System
desc: Specialized supply chain and production tracking system for textile manufacturing.
overview: A garment production manager tracking raw material supply, dye inventory, sewing line capacity, and shipment milestones.
challenges: Tracking item quantities across multiple sub-assembly stages without lag.
Dealing with unpredictable changes in dye and fabric inventory levels.
Integrating external logistics tracking data with interior assembly pipelines.
solutions: Designed a visual Kanban production board powered by web sockets.
Created a multi-warehouse inventory module utilizing double-entry inventory patterns.
Developed an API connector to sync shipment statuses with international carriers.
impact: Improved supply chain visibility, lowering material waste by 18% and cutting production delivery delays.

title: Point of Sale (POS)
desc: Retail POS system featuring offline transactions and central inventory syncing.
overview: A retail cash register application that operates offline and automatically syncs local transactions back to the cloud when internet returns.
challenges: Synchronizing multi-outlet transactions with central inventory without data loss.
Keeping transaction latency below 100ms on low-spec client hardware.
Directly interfacing with POS receipt printers and barcode scanners on the browser client.
solutions: Built a local-first browser IndexedDB structure that queues sync events.
Optimized React state renders and query paths to run efficiently on low-spec PCs.
Designed a modular client-side printer driver communicating via native browser print APIs.
impact: Deployed across dozens of checkout lanes, maintaining 99.9% inventory sync accuracy even during local internet dropouts.

title: Money Management App
desc: Personal ledger and budget tracker featuring receipt parsing and double-entry book balancing.
overview: A privacy-first mobile/web financial ledger offering real-time budget forecasting, bank feed integrations, and OCR-based receipt categorization.
challenges: Achieving secure, automated bank account transaction syncing.
Parsing unstructured physical receipt images accurately and quickly.
Ensuring mathematical balance reconciliation for multi-currency accounts.
solutions: Integrated with Plaid API and designed double-entry ledger database models.
Utilized OCR pipelines and lightweight NLP parsing for transaction categorization.
Built transactional ledger engines with atomic operations to prevent imbalances.
impact: Helped users categorize over $500k in personal transactions with receipt match rates exceeding 92%.

title: Sportslover.Live
desc: Real-time sports blogging and match score tracking platform.
overview: A live-syncing sports coverage platform delivering real-time match events, live commentary feeds, and custom blogging capabilities for active sports fans.
challenges: Caching live match updates to avoid database query surges during peak viewership.
Delivering immediate event alerts and commentary to thousands of active browser sessions.
Maintaining responsive layouts for dynamic data widgets on mobile connections.
solutions: Configured Redis cache stores to buffer live match statistics and score states.
Integrated Pusher and Laravel Echo WebSocket clients to stream match events without HTTP polling.
Built lightweight, performance-tuned UI widgets using Next.js client components.
impact: Successfully launched and scaled to serve live game updates within 1 second of occurrence to thousands of active monthly users.
